run_blacklist_urls_cli: run the script to filter blacklisted URLs from a directory of text files and write cleaned output
test_domain_is_in_blacklist: test the domain_is_in_blacklist function to check if a URL domain is in the blacklist set
test_extention_is_in_blacklist: test the extention_is_in_blacklist function to check if a URL file extension is blacklisted
test_url_is_malformed: test the url_is_malformed function to validate whether a URL matches the expected regex pattern
review_print_progress: review the print_progress function that prints elapsed time and URL filtering counters
